parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the refrigerator is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that supports the internal and external components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity, insulation housing, and support for the door and internal compartments.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the refrigerator is made of stainless steel and includes a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the refrigerator compartment to maintain internal temperature and provides access to the interior.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges to open and close, allowing user access to the refrigerator interior.
